recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If an external EncounterHistory artifact needs a similar wording audit, handle it in the owning repository or IG; no core FHIR source change is warranted for FHIR-14499.
issue_request: FHIR-14499 was a Published/Persuasive PA STU3 change request asking to replace the misleading Encounter.class and class-history code-list-style definition, "inpatient | outpatient | ambulatory | emergency +", with wording that treats ambulatory/outpatient as one concept and allows local variation.
initial_application: Commit 4fdf85c350a3a25537f1e0ac9dc514feaf42f41a, "GF#14499:Encounter.class description updated GF#14477:Encounter.serviceType binding fixed", changed the old Encounter spreadsheet source for Encounter.class from the stale list to the requested replacement wording. The old classHistory.class text appears to have survived historically until later Encounter refactoring removed classHistory from Encounter.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes encounter=Encounter, so source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml is in build scope. The current Encounter.class definition exactly uses the requested ambulatory (outpatient) wording. Encounter.classHistory is now only represented by migration notes to EncounterHistory and no source/encounterhistory resource remains in this core checkout. Later Encounter.class value-set work in FHIR-32341 and duplicate/background FHIR-32974 addressed broader cardinality, binding, and value-set concerns without contradicting this wording.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no current core source hunk is needed: the active Encounter.class definition is already correct and the class-history surface named in the old issue is not a current core element.

related_jiras.note: Later Published PA issue changed Encounter.class cardinality, binding strength, and value-set approach; it does not conflict with the FHIR-14499 definition wording.
Duplicate R5 concern about Encounter.class value-set ambiguity, closed as covered by FHIR-32341 rather than requiring an independent wording change here.
Unresolved UTG proposal about making OBSENC a child of AMB; terminology work outside this final core-source reconciliation.
